thread:
Alex: FYI seeing a surge of mTLS handshake failures in us-west egress since 08:03 UTC. rotator logs show KMS Unwrap AccessDenied after last night's RBAC prune.

Tess: can you paste the error line?

Alex: `2026-04-10T08:03:21Z rotator: UnwrapError: AccessDenied: missing kms:Decrypt for serviceAccount:svc-rotator@infra`

audit-bot: ALERT: 57 handshake failures in 7m. Related IAM change: terraform apply `keystore-prune-2026-04-09` at 2026-04-09T23:45Z. Raw events: /internal/audit/keystore-prune-2026-04-09.ndjson

Sam: quick mitigation: add temporary project-level binding for svc-rotator and restart rotator pods in canary. I'll run the command and annotate with emergency=true.

oncall: applying hotfix to canary now. command: `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding infra-prod --member=serviceAccount:svc-rotator@infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/keystoreAccess`

oncall: canary result: TLS handshakes back to baseline for api-gateway. inference-proxy canary improving.

Tess: next steps: 1) create terraform rollback or managed exception 2) fix audit sink so SetIamPolicy events include requester 3) add CI preflight that simulates a KMS unwrap with the new principal before merging role prunes.

Alex: agreed. I'll open an incident ticket with logs, commands used, and timeline. tagging infra + security for follow-up. :clipboard:

audit-bot: NOTE: some SetIamPolicy entries missing requester field; recovering raw log bundles may be necessary for full RCA.

Sam: also recommend rotating session ticket keys to avoid masking failures via resumption. small follow-up runbook item.

Alex: thanks all. keeping this thread for incident follow-up. :thumbsup:
